name: v1.12.0
body:
## Features

* **http1:** add max_header_size limit for server and client (#4183) ([d1cd14ef](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/d1cd14eff392be63a2318d690cc9380723ec61a1), closes [#3832](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/issues/3832))

## Bug Fixes

* **http1:**
  * withdraw a stale want when the client dispatcher takes a request (#4208) ([c44f1cc5](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/c44f1cc51c2bc45b502031a646d3d54315bd7a16))
  * remove content-length if transfer-encoding is auto-added (#4224) ([69396fdd](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/69396fdd960629d69b09cc6c9b367ef8650c001d))
  * always remove content-length if transfer-encoding is sent (#4223) ([a5d7fd78](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/a5d7fd7861598c0b8c857cb75240a75bcfbd96a3))
  * let a Connection close token win over a later keep-alive (#4201) ([5dadff76](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/5dadff76d1cb5d21046218df3568569fbba8ed21))
  * preserve hop-by-hop when setting close or keep-alive (#4196) ([74a39081](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/74a39081ff1496970fb75da75c5282b23a9b69e5))
* **http2:** do not reserve capacity for idle Upgraded streams (#4198) ([e89d0d93](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/e89d0d93d9566210ee95aea234a00952ebc4a202))

## Everything
* docs: fix typo responsibile -> responsible by @vaibhav8a in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4177
* style: replace single-character lifetime names with descriptive names by @dox4 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4173
* refactor(http1): resolve collapsible_match lint by @nakaryo716 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4178
* hyper Improvement Proposals by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4131
* perf(body): simpler custom Incoming channel by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4168
* docs(maintainers): add 0x676e67 as a collaborator by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4184
* fix(ext): remove broken `OriginalHeaderOrder` doctest by @cratelyn in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4188
* build(deps): remove unused `futures-channel` from `http1` feature by @0x676e67 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4185
* chore(ci): update to cargo-check-external-types 0.5.0 by @tottoto in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4189
* style(lib): address ignored_unit_patterns lint by @nakaryo716 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4193
* Preserve hop-by-hop when setting close or keep-alive by @dtolnay in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4196
* fix(http2): do not reserve capacity for idle Upgraded streams by @Dev-next-gen in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4198
* style(lib): Address clippy panics and missing_panics_doc lints by @Siech0 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4191
* docs: fix typos in capi README, MSRV and governance docs by @toyeshhm in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4204
* style(lib): Address trivial, low quantity clippy lints. by @Siech0 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4190
* chore(clippy): allow clippy lints following 1.99.0 release by @dswij in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4219
* style: remove useless_borrows_in_formatting from the clippy allowlist by @ump45nose in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4220
* style(h1): mark partial Debug impls as non-exhaustive by @badimalex in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4218
* style(lib): Address cast-possible-truncation clippy findings. by @Siech0 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4192
* feat(http1): add max_header_size limit for server and client by @Aditya-9-6 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4183
* fix(http1): let a Connection close token win over a later keep-alive by @shoemoney in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4201
* fix(http1): always remove content-length if transfer-encoding is sent by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4223
* fix(http1): remove invalid content-length if transfer-encoding is auto-added by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4224
* fix(http1): withdraw a stale want when the client dispatcher takes a request by @shodoco in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4208
* perf(body): skip waking a closed peer when a channel end drops by @0x676e67 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4225
* Prepare v1.12.0 by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4226

* @badimalex made their first contribution in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4218
* @Aditya-9-6 made their first contribution in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4183
* @shoemoney made their first contribution in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4201
* @shodoco made their first contribution in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4208
